group.label: General
group.comment:
Configures the UCP business profile served at /.well-known/ucp. Protocol version 2026-08-25. Profile structure verified against ucp.dev.

Upgraded from 1.x? The advertised protocol version changed from 2026-04-08 to 2026-08-25, and signing keys moved to the profile's canonical keys[] array. If any platform still integrates against your old profile, publish a frozen copy of it and list it under Advanced → Supported Versions.

field.label: Advertise UCP Profile
field.comment: When disabled, /.well-known/ucp returns a 404. Disable on stores that should not be discoverable by AI agents.

group.label: Declared Root Capabilities
group.comment: This module advertises capabilities; it does not implement the matching REST endpoints. Only enable a capability when the corresponding endpoint implementation is installed and reachable at the configured Transport endpoint. Advertising an unimplemented capability will cause AI platforms to send requests that fail.

field.label: Identity Linking (dev.ucp.common.identity_linking)
field.comment: Requires a working OAuth 2.0 server. Per the UCP spec, businesses declaring identity linking must publish OAuth 2.0 authorization server metadata at /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (RFC 8414). This module does not provide that endpoint — only enable this capability when your OAuth server and its metadata document are live.

field.label: Identity Linking OAuth Scopes
field.comment: Comma-separated scope list advertised in config.scopes, e.g. dev.ucp.shopping.order:read, dev.ucp.shopping.order:manage. Leave blank to omit the config block.

field.label: Permalink (dev.ucp.shopping.permalink)
field.comment: New in protocol version 2026-08-25. Lets an agent hand the shopper a real, buyable URL on your storefront instead of transacting through the API. Unlike the other capabilities, this one needs no UCP endpoint module — a stock Magento cart URL already satisfies it, so it is safe to enable on any store.

field.label: Permalink Endpoint URL
field.comment: Published as config.endpoint. Leave blank to use {baseUrl}/checkout/cart, which is where Magento's own add-to-cart links resolve. Must be HTTPS.

group.label: Declared Extensions
group.comment: Extensions augment a parent capability via the extends field. Per spec, an extension is never advertised when its parent capability is disabled (it would be pruned during negotiation anyway).

field.label: Fulfillment (dev.ucp.shopping.fulfillment)
field.comment: Extends Checkout. Only advertised when Checkout is enabled.

field.label: Discount (dev.ucp.shopping.discount)
field.comment: Extends Checkout and/or Cart. Only advertised when at least one parent is enabled.

field.label: Buyer Consent (dev.ucp.shopping.buyer_consent)
field.comment: New in protocol version 2026-08-25. Lets an agent collect marketing, analytics and sale-or-sharing consent on your behalf during cart or checkout. Extends Checkout and/or Cart. Only enable this once your checkout integration actually records the consent it receives — advertising it otherwise means agents collect consent that is then silently dropped.

field.label: REST Endpoint URL
field.comment: Base URL for the dev.ucp.shopping REST service. Leave blank to use {baseUrl}/rest/V1/ucp. Must be HTTPS; must not end with a trailing slash (trailing slashes are stripped automatically).

field.label: MCP Endpoint URL
field.comment: Optional. HTTPS URL of your MCP server's Streamable HTTP endpoint (e.g. from angeo/module-mcp-server). When set, the profile advertises an additional mcp transport binding for dev.ucp.shopping alongside REST. Leave empty if you do not run an MCP server — unlike the REST endpoint, this is never derived automatically.

group.label: Signing Keys
group.comment:
Generated via CLI: bin/magento angeo:ucp:keys:generate. Only the public JWKs are stored here; the private PEM is printed once and must be placed in app/etc/env.php by the operator.

Published as the profile's top-level keys[] array (RFC 7517 JWK Set). Rotate without downtime by publishing the new key alongside the old one (--add), moving signing over, and only then removing the old entry — a key is not effectively revoked until it is absent from this array.

field.label: Public JWK Set (read-only)
field.comment: JSON array of public JWKs, populated by angeo:ucp:keys:generate. Edit only if you know what you are doing — manual edits can desync from the private PEM in env.php.

group.label: Advanced Profile Declarations
group.comment: Optional spec features for advanced deployments. Invalid JSON is ignored with a warning in system.log.

field.label: Supported Versions (JSON)
field.comment: Map of older protocol versions to version-specific profile URIs, e.g. {"2026-04-08": "https://yourstore.com/ucp/profiles/2026-04-08.json"}. Keys must be YYYY-MM-DD; URIs must be HTTPS. Each URI must serve a complete, self-contained profile for that version — this module serves only the current one, so the older profile has to be a static file you host yourself.

field.label: Payment Handlers (JSON)
field.comment: Raw payment_handlers object per the UCP spec, keyed by reverse-domain handler name. Only declare handlers your checkout integration actually supports. Do not place secret keys here — handler config in the profile is public.
